run_gen_py_list: run the script to rename dataset folders from space-separated to underscore-separated names and generate a train list file with video paths and class labels
run_gen_py_list_val: run the script to process validation dataset folders and generate a validation list file with video paths and class labels
run_gen_py_list_rename: run the script to rename video class folders by replacing spaces with underscores in their names
run_gen_py_list_generate_list: run the script to generate a text list file mapping each video file path to its class label index
run_gen_py_list_count_classes: run the script to count how many of the 400 Kinetics classes have been processed and written to the output list
